propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria bullets that are invisible to acceptance criteria counting and cannot carry operator attestation tags
A migration script must convert Success Criteria bullets to Acceptance Criteria checkboxes and merge them into the AC block, handling both orders and existing AC blocks
Migrating non-closed tickets invalidates their plan-review attestations as stale-material and requires an explicit flag to avoid silently invalidating in-flight claims
The migration rewrite must be order-agnostic, idempotent, and handle qualified headings and mixed checkbox/bullet formats without duplicating sections
All 106 migrated tickets must return _count_ac_items >= 1 and have no remaining Success Criteria headings after migration
